BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.BaiduOcrDesc: This component performs VAT invoice text recognition by calling the Baidu AI OCR API. It supports structured recognition of all fields for VAT ordinary invoices, special invoices, fully electronic invoices, roll invoices, and blockchain invoices, including basic invoice information, seller and purchaser information, commodity information, and tax details. The recognition accuracy of the five key fields exceeds 99.9%. Images uploaded must not exceed 4 MB.
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.BaiduOcrStep1Desc: Update the appsettings.json file with the following configuration. Please register on Baidu AI Open Platform and apply for relevant parameter values.

BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.InvoiceTypeOption6: Toll VAT electronic ordinary invoice: toll_elec_normal_invoice
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.InvoiceTypeOption7: Blockchain electronic invoice (currently Shenzhen only): blockchain_invoice

BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicNoteP2: You can set the UseCache="false" property of DataTableDynamicContext to disable the internal data cache, and update the DataTable property of DataTableDynamicContext in your own code logic to greatly improve system performance
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicNoteP3: You can refer to the pagination table sample code. Use CreatePageDataContext to create the DataTableDynamicContext instance. When clicking the pager, only the data is updated, and there is no need to recreate the DataTableDynamicContext instance
